items: [Wide Arc Lighting Area] The solar flood lights can adjust the 3 lamp heads providing an industry leading 270°Wide angle of illumination. The solar motion light has 3 lighting modes: (1) Mode 1 -Lights set on low brightness setting at all times and will illuminate brightly when motion sensor is activated. (2) Mode 2-lights will be off and will illuminate brightly when motion sensor is activated. (3) Mode 3 -lights will be on low light throughout the night and motion sensor is inactivated.

[High-Efficiency Solar Panels & High-Capacity Battery] Intelamp solar security lights are equipped with high-power solar panels for efficient energy absorption and fast charging. The built-in high-capacity battery stores ample energy, allowing the lights to operate for up to 3 consecutive nights in motion-sensing mode after a full day of charging. Each light delivers a bright and consistent output of 1200 lumens, ensuring reliable performance even in low-sunlight conditions.

[Dual Sensor Design] Intelamp solar light is equipped with dual motion sensors that provide a wide detection range of over 180°. This allows it to detect motion from both the front and the sides, ensuring comprehensive coverage and enhanced security.

【Easy Installation】Each package is equipped with screws and tie straps for you to install the solar flood lights outdoor where you need them most. The solar sensor lights can be screwed to all hard surfaces such as walls, wooden fences and garage door frames or bound to trees or posts with the tie straps provided.

【Two Years of Service Life for the Solar Light】 As a professional solar lighting producer intelamp stands by this solar motion sensor light. With a comprehensive installation manual and impressive after sales service team customer satisfaction is guaranteed.
